inputs:geonames/dump-2026-10-15.title: GeoNames: the full dump (allCountries), alternate names, admin1 codes and country info (2026-10-15)
inputs:geonames/dump-2026-10-15.description: The GeoNames data dump as offered on 2026-10-15 (files dated 2026-10-15 by the server): allCountries.zip (all features, one line per GeoNames record: id, name, ASCII name, alternate names, coordinates, feature class and code, country, admin codes, population, ...), alternateNamesV2.zip (the alternate names with their language, preferred/short/colloquial/historic flags), admin1CodesASCII.txt (names of the first-level administrative divisions), countryInfo.txt (countries), readme.txt (the format). inputs:geonames/dump-2026-10-15.note: Not published: a copy of a third-party dump (CC BY 4.0), kept to make datasets that match places against GeoNames again without network access.
